results.content: # The 2026 Emmys: ‘Widow’s Bay’ and star Matthew Rhys win big on a historic night. • **Remarkable debut:** “Widow’s Bay” won best comedy series at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, capping a huge night for Apple TV’s new genre-bending thriller. Matthew Rhys became the first man to win two lead actor categories in the same year for his work on that show and the limited series “The Beast in Me.” “Widow’s Bay” also swept the supporting role in a comedy categories and nabbed writing and directing awards. **• More big winners:** Jean Smart made history with a fifth consecutive win for her starring role in the comedy “Hacks.” “The Pitt” took home best drama series and a win for lead actor Noah Wyle.
